title: Workload Snapshotter + Continuous Batching Tuner (safe apply/rollback)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Develop a workload snapshotter service and continuous batching tuner that generates per-customer workload fingerprints, proposes safe batching and KV-caching configurations, and applies changes via staged rollouts with automatic rollback on regression. The feature should integrate with Console telemetry, support dry-run evaluation using historical Kinesis telemetry, and expose an approval flow for enterprise accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshotter produces workload fingerprints for 95% of active routes within 24 hours of enablement
Tuner suggests batching parameters (max_batch_size, target_latency_p99, coalescing_window_ms, kv_cache_prefix_ratio) per workload with expected cost savings estimate and confidence score
Automated canary rollout applies changes to 1%/10%/100% with automatic rollback within 5 minutes on latency or error regression
Dry-run mode validates recommendations against historical request traces without applying them
Console UI displays per-route before/after cost and latency projections and a link to related telemetry
implementation_notes: Component: workload-snapshotter (stateless job consuming messaging topic with sample windows, stores fingerprints as TTL entries in metadata store)
Component: continuous-tuner (policy engine that maps fingerprints to candidate configs using heuristics + bayesian bandit for exploration)
Safety net: staged canary with traffic shards, rollback window, and telemetry-based regression detectors (p99 latency, error-rate, token-cost)
Metrics: add new telemetry keys batch_recommendation_confidence, snapshot_version, tuner_trial_id to Console dashboards
APIs: POST /v1/internal/batching/recommendations to request suggestions, PATCH /v1/internal/batching/apply to start rollout with dry_run flag
Data privacy: snapshotter strips PII and only stores hash of prompt length distributions and token histograms
